description: Header file defining the prplmesh_cli class and related enums and constants for prplMesh command-line interface operations, including network configuration, device topology, and status functions.

classes.name: prplmesh_cli
classes.description: Class providing CLI operations for prplMesh, including network management, device info, and status reporting.

methods.name: get_ip_from_iface
methods.description: Retrieves IP address associated with a network interface.

methods.name: prpl_conn_map
methods.description: Retrieves the connection map of devices.

methods.name: print_help
methods.description: Displays help information for CLI usage.

methods.name: get_operating_mode
methods.description: Determines the current operating mode of the system.

methods.name: get_ap_path
methods.description: Gets the path of an access point by index or SSID.

methods.name: show_ap
methods.description: Displays details of existing access points.

methods.name: set_ssid
methods.description: Sets the SSID for a specified access point.

methods.name: set_security
methods.description: Configures security settings for an access point.

methods.name: print_device_info
methods.description: Recursively prints topology information of devices.

methods.name: print_radio
methods.description: Prints information about a radio device.

methods.name: print_mode
methods.description: Prints the current prplMesh operational mode.

methods.name: get_freq_from_class
methods.description: Returns frequency based on operating class.
